name: wask-comment-picker
description: Pick random giveaway winners from the comments of public Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, and TikTok posts and videos.

interface.longDescription:
WASK Comment Picker helps creators, influencers, and businesses select random winners for Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, and TikTok giveaways, contests, and promotions directly in ChatGPT. Easily pick giveaway winners from post and video comments with a simple, fair, and transparent random winner selection process.
Whether you’re running an Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, or TikTok giveaway, influencer promotion, brand contest, or social media campaign, WASK makes it easy to select random winners directly through ChatGPT.
Simply provide your giveaway post or video and let WASK help you pick the winners.
capabilities: Pick random winners from Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, and TikTok comments
defaultPrompt: Pick 3 random winners from this post: <link>
What happened to my last giveaway?

positive.description: Pick 3 random winners from a public Instagram post.
positive.prompt: Pick 3 random winners from this Instagram post: https://www.instagram.com/galatasaray/p/DecyW28kfxc/
positive.expected_behavior: The giveaway starts, ChatGPT says the draw has begun, then returns 3 winner usernames and a shareable results link that opens the public results page for the post.

positive.prompt: Pick one winner from this post's comments, only counting comments that tag at least one friend: https://www.instagram.com/galatasaray/p/DecyW28kfxc/
positive.expected_behavior: The giveaway runs with minimum_mention = 1 and returns one winner whose comment tags at least one account, plus the results link.
Returns the demo account's pending and past giveaways with the post link, status, and winner count.

positive.prompt: What happened to my last giveaway?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent giveaway and returns its status, winner usernames, and results link.

positive.description: End-to-end flow shown in the demo video.
positive.prompt: I'm running a giveaway on this post, pick 2 winners: https://www.instagram.com/galatasaray/p/DecyW28kfxc/
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT confirms the draw has started, waits until it finishes, then lists 2 winners and the results link; opening the link shows the post and the winners.

negative.description: Invalid or private post URL is rejected with a clear error.
negative.expected_behavior: The tool returns a clear error that the post could not be found or is not public. No winners are returned.

negative.description: Posting or replying on social media is refused.
negative.prompt: Post a comment on my Instagram post announcing the winners.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains that WASK Comment Picker only reads public comments to pick winners and cannot post, comment, or reply on social media. No tool is called.

negative.description: Out-of-scope request does not trigger any tool.
negative.prompt: Increase my Facebook ad budget by 20%.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains this is outside what WASK Comment Picker does (picking giveaway winners from post comments). No tool is called.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds Facebook, X, YouTube, and TikTok: pick random giveaway winners from the comments of public posts and videos on these platforms, in addition to Instagram.
